title: Telefoonnada Casriga ah ee Shaashadaha Isku-laabma (Foldable Phones) oo Qiimahoodu Hoos u Dhacayo
excerpt: Shirkadaha soo saara telefoonnada sida Samsung, Xiaomi, iyo Motorola ayaa qorsheynaya inay suuqa keenaan telefoonnada la laabo oo qiimo jaban, si ay u soo jiitaan macaamiil badan.
body: Telefoonnada shaashadda weyn ee laalaabma waxay muddo dheer ahaayeen kuwa aad u qaali ah oo ay iibsan karaan kaliya dadka dhaqaalaha dambeeya leh (inta badan ka sarreeya $1,500). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, tignoolajiyada samaynta shaashadahan (OLED displays) oo hadda noqotay mid fudud iyo tartanka suuqa oo kordhay awgeed, shirkadaha ayaa bilaabay inay soo saaraan moodallo ka hooseeya $600. Tani waxay la dhigan tahay in sannadkan dhexdiisa ay telefoonnada laalaabma noqon doonaan kuwa qof kastaa iibsan karo.
author: MaqaalTech Staff

title: Boston Dynamics Unveils Atlas 2.0 with Full-Body AI Control
excerpt: The humanoid robot now uses end-to-end neural networks for locomotion and manipulation, eliminating hand-crafted control systems.
body: Boston Dynamics has demonstrated Atlas 2.0, featuring a complete overhaul of its control architecture. The robot now uses a single neural network trained via reinforcement learning to control all joints simultaneously.
author: MaqaalTech Staff

title: EU AI Act Enforcement Begins: What Companies Need to Know
excerpt: The world's first comprehensive AI regulation framework enters its enforcement phase, with fines up to 6% of global revenue.
body: The European Union's AI Act has entered its first major enforcement phase. Companies deploying AI systems classified as high-risk must now comply with strict transparency, documentation, and testing requirements.
author: MaqaalTech Staff

title: NVIDIA Blackwell B200 GPUs Ship to Data Centers Globally
excerpt: The next-generation AI accelerator delivers 4x the performance of H100 with improved energy efficiency for large-scale model training.
body: NVIDIA has begun mass shipments of its Blackwell B200 GPUs to hyperscale data centers. Early benchmarks show 4x improvement in AI training throughput compared to the H100, while energy consumption per FLOP improves by 40%.
author: MaqaalTech Staff
